simple.meaning: כָּסַח (kâçach) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to cut off.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.

definitions.full: H3683. kasach [ כָּסַח ] verb cut off or away , a plant (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic כְּסַח , (for Hebrew זָמַר ); Arabic sweep off, away, destroy, do away with ; compare Sabean כסח overpower, conquer , Hom ZMG 1892, 532 ) — only Qal Passive participle , feminine singular כְּסוּחָה Psa 80:17 , cut away , of Israel under figure of vine; masculine plural כְּסוּחִים קוֺצִים Isa 33:12 thorns cut away , figurative of peoples destroyed by divine judgment.

occurrences.englishText: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand,
